# TalentCards

> TalentCards is a mobile-first learning platform specializing in microlearning and reinforcement training for deskless workers across retail, manufacturing, consulting, and other industries.

TalentCards provides AI-powered mobile training solutions designed for on-the-job learning, compliance training, employee onboarding, and continuous skill reinforcement using spaced repetition techniques. The platform serves enterprises and trainers looking to deliver engaging microlearning content to distributed workforces.
